name: 115.简

basedOn.note: Test5 and Test6 both returned zero results for a keyword that the legacy search had already proved valid. Further inspection confirmed the current 115 client can run in either WebAPI Cookie mode or OpenAPI Bearer mode; the previous search rewrite always forced a WebAPI search endpoint onto the captured file-list transport.

features: detect the real authenticated file-list mode from client.getFiles() before searching
OpenAPI mode: preserve Bearer authentication and retarget /open/ufile/files to GET /open/ufile/search
WebAPI mode: preserve Cookie authentication and retarget /files to /files/search with the established aid=7 search contract
use the correct OpenAPI search fields: file_id, parent_id, file_name, file_size, pick_code, user_utime and file_category
use OpenAPI fc/type mappings and WebAPI type mappings separately instead of sharing one incompatible filter mapping
folder results route the real folder ID into enhanced File Management; videos continue through the existing player resolver; other files open File Information
retain the visible homepage search confirmation button and all Test4+ file-management/recycle/magnet/login modules unchanged
no concurrent polling and no extra background requests
evidence: 115 Open Platform search contract: GET /open/ufile/search with Bearer access_token; search_value/limit/offset required; fc=1 folder, fc=2 file; type 1 document, 2 image, 3 audio, 4 video, 5 archive; directory result file_category=0 and file file_category=1
maintained WebAPI driver contract: /files/search uses aid=7, cid=0, search_value, offset, limit, type, count_folders, o and asc
